patterns.note: Full-width sections with high-contrast background colors create strong visual breaks and define distinct content areas.
Extreme scale contrast is used, featuring oversized, bold, wide sans-serif display headings that dominate the page, juxtaposed with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
A high-contrast, limited color palette of black, white, and a vibrant, almost neon, yellow/lime green is used, with purple serving as a secondary accent color.
Sections reveal with a scroll-triggered animation, sliding up from the bottom and fading into view as they enter the viewport.
Large display text elements feature a distinctive pixelated or glitch distortion effect, contributing to a digital and experimental aesthetic.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system (like GSAP ScrollTrigger) that slides them up from the bottom and fades them in as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.
Key display text elements feature a dynamic pixelation or glitch distortion effect, likely implemented using a WebGL shader or SVG filter, which may animate on load or as they become visible.
The hero section employs a layered composition where a large, static text overlay scrolls over a detailed illustration with floating UI elements, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, wide sans-serif headings (up to ~8x body text size) create a dominant visual hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all elements, including buttons, cards, and section edges, contributing to a crisp, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around large text elements, contributing to a bold and impactful presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extreme, distorted typography, particularly the pixelated/glitch effect on large headings, combined with a high-contrast, almost neon, color palette (black, white, vibrant yellow, purple) creates a unique, edgy, and digital-native aesthetic that feels experimental and bold.
